Legacy Timeline

OUR HISTORY
ROAD MAP

A timeline of milestones, innovations, and achievements that shaped who we are today a journey built on vision, dedication, and trust.

1972

Bhaiya Group

Bhaiya Group of Industries is one of Bangladesh's most prominent and diversified conglomerates. With a legacy spanning over 50 years nto a multifaceted organization with interests in food manufacturing, real estate, insurance, hospitality, and more.

Founded by Alhaj Moksud Ali, the group has grown into a multifaceted organization with interests in food manufacturing, real estate, insurance, hospitality, and more.

1983

Nabisco Biscuit &
Bread Factory

Nabisco Biscuit & Bread Factory is one of Bangladesh's oldest and most recognizable biscuit companies. Renowned for its wide range of biscuits, breads, cakes, and other bakery products.

Established in the 1980s, the company became a private limited entity in 1983 and operates independent units. A well-loved brand with roots in wholesale trade and distribution.

2012

Bhaiya Housing

Bhaiya Housing Ltd. is a prominent real estate developer in Bangladesh. Established in 2012 as part of the Bhaiya Group of Industries.

Headquartered in Dhaka, the developer creates luxury residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects. A member of the Real Estate & Housing Association of Bangladesh (REHAB).

2022

Rupali
Bangladesh

Rupali Bangladesh is an influential newspaper and media outlet in Bangladesh. Focusing on comprehensive news coverage on local and national events.

Established as a digital-first platform, it quickly gained popularity and became a respected voice in journalism.
